concept: AWS Config: configuration history and continuous compliance
tests: Distinguishing Config from CloudTrail/CloudWatch/Trusted Advisor for recording configuration changes and continuously checking rules.
expected: AWS Config: configuration history + managed/custom Config rules for continuous compliance evaluation. Triggers: "record of every configuration change", "evaluate against compliance rules continuously".
why_not: CloudTrail — who called the API, not resource state over time; CloudWatch — metrics and logs; Trusted Advisor — point-in-time best-practice checks.
